# Top Bike Tours Portugal | Cycling Trips Portugal

Explore Portugal on a bike tour! Guided & self-guided biking holidays with luxury stays, scenic routes & full support. Book your cycling trip today!

### Cycling guides
In-depth, regularly updated guides written by the team that designs and guides the tours. Each opens with a short quotable answer, then covers routes, seasons, difficulty, where to stay and what to eat.
- [Cycling guides](https://topbiketoursportugal.com/guides/): Index of all guides, plus a GPX route library.
- [Cycling in Portugal](https://topbiketoursportugal.com/guides/cycling-in-portugal/): The pillar guide — regions, best time to go, difficulty, safety, bikes, guided vs self-guided, packing.
- [Porto to Lisbon by bike](https://topbiketoursportugal.com/guides/porto-to-lisbon-by-bike/): The Atlantic coast route stage by stage, with where to stay and what to eat.
- [Cycling the Portuguese Camino](https://topbiketoursportugal.com/guides/cycling-the-portuguese-camino/): Porto to Santiago de Compostela by bike — coastal and central ways, cycling vs walking, French Way comparison.
- [Cycling the Algarve](https://topbiketoursportugal.com/guides/cycling-the-algarve/): Vicentine Coast and Algarve routes, seasons, gravel loops and accommodation.
- [Self-guided bike tours in Portugal](https://topbiketoursportugal.com/guides/self-guided-bike-tours-portugal/): How self-guided trips work, guided vs self-guided, what is included.
- [Cycling the Douro Valley](https://topbiketoursportugal.com/guides/cycling-the-douro-valley/): Douro and Trás-os-Montes routes, wine, climbs, Minho vs Douro, where to stay.

## Specific Tours
### Coastal and Scenic Routes
- [Porto to Santiago de Compostela Bike Tour - Costal Path](https://topbiketoursportugal.com/tours/porto-santiago-compostela-bike-tour/): Experience the stunning coastal path from Porto to Santiago de Compostela.
- [Porto to Lisbon Bike tour - The green Coast and the Silver Coast](https://topbiketoursportugal.com/tours/porto-to-lisbon-cycling-tour-en/): Enjoy a scenic ride from Porto to Lisbon along the green and silver coasts.
- [The Silver Coast - Porto to Coimbra](https://topbiketoursportugal.com/tours/porto-to-coimbra-biketour/): Cycle through the picturesque Silver Coast from Porto to Coimbra.
- [Vicentine Coast and Algarve Bike Tour](https://topbiketoursportugal.com/tours/south-portugal-biketour/): Explore the beautiful Vicentine Coast and the Algarve region on this biking adventure.

### Wine and Cultural Tours
- [Douro Valley Bike Tour](https://topbiketoursportugal.com/tours/bike-tours-douro-valley/): Discover the breathtaking Douro Valley, famous for its wine production.
- [Silver Coast Bike tours - Cycling from Coimbra to Lisbon](https://topbiketoursportugal.com/tours/from-coimbra-to-lisbon-bike-tour/): A unique cycling experience from Coimbra to Lisbon along the Silver Coast.
- [More of Alentejo Wine & Castles Cycling Tour](https://topbiketoursportugal.com/tours/more-of-biking-alentejo-wine-country-and-castles/): Delve into the rich culture and wine of Alentejo while visiting historic castles.
- [Alentejo Wine country and Castles Bike Tour](https://topbiketoursportugal.com/tours/alentejo-wine-heritage-bicycle-tour/): Explore the scenic wine country and majestic castles of Alentejo.

### Gentle Trails and Historical Routes
- [Biking on Gentle Trails in the Heart of Portugal](https://topbiketoursportugal.com/tours/electric-biking-coimbra-to-aveiro-loop/): Enjoy a leisurely biking experience on gentle trails through Portugal's heartland.
- [Camino de Santiago French Way by bike | Top Bike Tours Portugal](https://topbiketoursportugal.com/tours/bike-tour-camino-de-santiago-cycling-french-way-leon/): Experience the famous Camino de Santiago on a bike, following the French Way.
- [Douro Wine Tour "Easy"](https://topbiketoursportugal.com/tours/bike-tours-douro-valley-easy/): A relaxed biking tour through the beautiful Douro wine region.
- [Camino de Santiago Bike Tour - Top Bike Tours Portugal](https://topbiketoursportugal.com/tours/santiago-de-compostela/): Join us for a memorable biking journey along the Camino de Santiago.
- [Trás-os-Montes & Douro international](https://topbiketoursportugal.com/tours/bike-tours-portugal-douro-wine/): Explore the international routes of Trás-os-Montes and the Douro region.
- [Camino de Santiago Bike Tours (The Way of St. James Bike Tour)](https://topbiketoursportugal.com/tours/french-way-to-santiago-bike-tour/): Participate in our specialized bike tours along the historic Way of St. James.

## Regions Covered
- [Algarve](https://topbiketoursportugal.com/tours/regions/algarve/): Discover the stunning landscapes and beaches of the Algarve region.
- [Porto/North](https://topbiketoursportugal.com/tours/regions/porto/): Explore the northern regions of Portugal, including Porto.
- [Douro](https://topbiketoursportugal.com/tours/regions/douro-river/): Experience the beauty of the Douro Valley.
- [Alentejo](https://topbiketoursportugal.com/tours/regions/alentejo/): Cycle through the vast and beautiful Alentejo region.
- [Lisboa](https://topbiketoursportugal.com/tours/regions/lisbon/): Enjoy biking in and around the vibrant city of Lisbon.
- [Santiago Compostela](https://topbiketoursportugal.com/tours/regions/santiago-compostela/): Learn about our tours that lead to the historic Santiago de Compostela.
